== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Magnetic Suction Tube (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. Compared with [[Magnetic Suction Tube]]. Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
